items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading dots: role=status with an accessible name (aria-label plus visually hidden text), decorative dots staggered over three cycles, then resting. Under reduced or off motion the dots never animate.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The dots are CSS squares and a Web Animation; no original assets are used.
